name: Team
description: Team / people section over a members collection. Layouts: photo grid with hover overlay and a click-to-open bio modal, flat card grid, paginated slider, edge slider overflowing to the right, table-like list rows, or grouped by department.
when_to_use: About/team pages and 'your contacts' sections. Use Contact (persons variant) when the people are primarily reachable contacts with a form next to them.
capabilities: grid with hover overlay and bio modal on click (dialog with photo, bio, contact links)
paginated slider with configurable members per page, plus an edge slider overflowing right
department grouping via a free-text department per member
per-member role, bio, photo, email, phone, and LinkedIn link

variants.description: Photo grid; hover shows an overlay, click opens the bio modal. Default.
Slider whose track overflows past the right container edge.
Members clustered under their department headings.

breakpoints.mobile: 1-2 columns; list rows stack their meta.
breakpoints.desktop: 3-4 column grid; slider shows a full page of members.

ai.prompt_summary: Team: people section. Settings: variant (grid|featured|slider|edge-slider|list|group), eyebrow, headline, intro, head_align (left|center), per_page (slider only, default 4). People in members[] (min 1): { name (required), role, department (group variant), bio, photo, email, phone, linkedin }.
ai.content_guidelines: 4-8 members. Roles 1-3 words; bios 2-3 sentences (shown in the modal / list). Consistent portrait crops.

field_hints.members.department: Only used by the group variant — members sharing a department appear under that heading.
field_hints.members.bio: Surfaces in the grid variant's modal and the list variant.
field_hints.per_page: Only applies to the slider variant.
